title: Constructibly closed sets stable under specialization are closed, and dually for open
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a constructibly closed subset stable under specialization of a spectral space is closed, and dually that a constructibly open subset stable under generalization is open, with the auxiliary statement that a point of the closure of a constructibly closed set is a specialization of a point of the set (author lemma at source lines 4677-4688, label lemma-constructible-stable-specialization-closed). The proof (source lines 4690-4712) uses the quasi-compact neighbourhood system and the finite intersection criterion for the first statement, derives the second immediately and the third by passing to the complement (proof lines 4690-4711). The neighbourhood intersection argument is the substance. H3.
